snippet.title: Stellar Courier
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012180/Stellar_Courier/
Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.
